title: Rate Card Extract: Percentage Applied to a Guest-Service-Fee Refund
content:
# Rate card extract — percentage of a guest-service-fee refund on a cancellation

**Rate rule.** The percentage the guest-service-fee refund on a cancelled reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category applies depends on the stay:

- a stay booked with the host-only fee structure applies the host-only-fee guest service fee percentage of its policy — 0.00% on every policy;
- a split-fee stay of 28 nights or more applies the split-fee guest service fee percentage of the stay's policy — 14.20% on Flexible, Moderate, Limited, Firm, Strict, Super Strict 30 Days and Super Strict 60 Days, and 12.00% on Long-Term;
- any other stay applies 14.20 percent.

The fee structure, the number of nights and the policy are those recorded on the stay.

## Decision list (hypothetical stays)

| Stay | Applied percentage |
|---|---|
| host-only fee, any length, any policy | 0.00% |
| split fee, 35 nights, Long-Term | 12.00% |
| split fee, 28 nights, Long-Term | 12.00% |
| split fee, 27 nights, Strict | 14.20% |
| split fee, 30 nights, Moderate (lengthened by a change) | 14.20% (Moderate's split-fee percentage) |

On a hypothetical fee base of 500.00, those percentages give 0.00, 60.00, 60.00, 71.00 and 71.00.
